coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 5 of 11 ground-truth items (45%): FP16 versus QuaRot 4-bit precision, batch size 1, prefill time, decode time, and peak memory usage. Memory measurement methodology differs from the required benchmark.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output varies model size instead of holding the specified LLaMa-2-7B model constant, omits e2e/benchmark.py and its fixed methodology, sweeps sequence lengths rather than fixing 2048, and uses 256 decode steps instead of 32. It does not explicitly specify combined end-to-end time or computed phase-specific speedup factors. Much of the design concerns additional ablations and analytical extrapolations rather than the requested benchmark.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not match the expected performance comparison.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the conclusion comparing QuaRot 4-bit and FP16 prefill time, decoding time, memory usage, and phase-specific speedup factors.
